translations.text: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came through Haggai the prophet, saying, “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the people of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and say:
“Thus says the Lord Almighty: These people say, ‘The time has not come to build the house of the Lord.’”
And the word of the Lord came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
“Is it time only for you to live in vaulted houses, while my house lies in ruins?”
“And now, thus says the Lord Almighty: Set your hearts on your ways.

You cultivated much but gathered little. You ate but were not satisfied. You drank but did not have enough. You clothed yourselves but were not warmed by your clothes. And whoever collected his wages collected them in bags full of holes.”
Thus says the Lord Almighty: “Set your hearts on your ways.
Go up the mountain, cut wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the Lord.

You looked for much, but it became little. You carried it into your houses, and I blew it away. For this reason, thus says the Lord Almighty: Because my house lies in ruins, while each of you hurries to his own house.
Because of this, the heavens will withhold your rain, and the earth will hold back its produce.
And I will bring a sword upon the land, upon the grain, upon the wine, upon the oil, upon everything that grows from the earth, upon people, upon livestock, and upon all the labor of their hands.”

And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the people of Judah, and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, just as the Lord their God had sent him to them. And the people feared the presence of the Lord.
And Haggai, the messenger of the Lord, said to the people, “I am with you, says the Lord.”

And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the people of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and worked on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God, on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the Lord spoke through Haggai the prophet, saying:
“Say to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the people of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people:
‘Who among you saw this house in its former glory? And how do you see it now? Is it like nothing before your eyes?’

And now be strong, Zerubbabel, says the Lord, and be strong, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and let all the people of the land be strong, says the Lord. And work, for I am with you, says the Lord Almighty.
And the word that I pledged to you when you came out of the land of the Egyptians, and my Spirit that remains among you—take courage.
For thus says the Lord Almighty: “Once again I will shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
And I will shake all the nations together, and the choicest treasures of all the nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the Lord Almighty.
The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, says the Lord Almighty.

For the later glory of this house will be greater than its former glory, says the Lord Almighty. And in this place I will give peace, says the Lord Almighty, and peace for the children, salvation for everyone who works to raise up this temple.”
On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet, saying:
“Thus says the Lord Almighty: Ask the priests about the law, and say:
‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and his clothing touches bread, broth, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered and said, “No.”
And Haggai said, “If someone who is defiled or unclean in soul touches any of these things, will it be defiled?” The priests answered and said, “It will be defiled.”

Haggai answered and said, “So it is with this people, and so it is with this nation before me, says the Lord. So it is with all the work of their hands: whatever comes into contact with it will be defiled because of their early gains. They will be tormented because of their evils, and you hated those who rebuked you at the gates.”
And now consider, from this day back to the time before stone was laid upon stone in the temple of the Lord: what was your condition?
When you put twenty cors of barley into your containers, there were only ten cors of barley. And when you went into your winepresses to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.
I struck you and all the work of your hands with barrenness, scorching wind, and hail, yet you did not return to me, says the Lord.
Set your hearts on this, from this day onward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, and from the day on which the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid. Consider it.
Will anything appear on the threshing floor? And the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate tree, and the olive tree, which bore no fruit—from this day I will bless them.
And the word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai the prophet on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying:
Say to Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah: “Once again I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and the dry land.

And I will overthrow the thrones of kings and destroy the power of the kings of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots and their riders, and the horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
On that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will take you, Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, my servant, and make you like a signet, for I am pleased with you, says the Lord Almighty.”
